name: Flight school

pf.license.need: none checked by Rosie: a flight school needs no state license in most places; where the state licenses flight schools as private or vocational schools, the business says so (a switch from the state form). Each instructor's federal flight instructor certificate is the business's own word
pf.license.who: the school for its own registration or any school license it holds; each instructor for their own certificate
pf.license.ask: optional: the business registration number and each instructor's certificate number, if the business wants them shown; nothing is asked to be checked
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never checks a license, certificate, insurance or aircraft paper (D96); the school keeps its own records
pf.license.aircraft: each aircraft's inspections and insurance are the school's own record; an aircraft the school says is down is not offered (the business's word)
pf.license.insurance: aircraft liability and hull insurance is the school's own matter; optional for the booking
pf.license.background: any background or security check is the school's own step, outside Rosie; Rosie never checks it
pf.license.renewals: a reminder the business sets for its own dates, if it wants one; a lapsed certificate is the owner's call to pause an instructor
pf.license.blocks: nothing: no license, certificate or insurance blocks a booking here; the owner decides who may fly for the school

pf.services.shape: a person's time (an instructor) plus an aircraft or the simulator for lessons; an aircraft or the simulator alone for a student's supervised solo, with an instructor on duty; seats on a timetable for the ground school course; flow B: an instructor at the customer's own aircraft and airport, and a ground school class at a host's place
pf.services.examples: the example school's own prices (Lee Flight School and Lee Flight Lessons), not a standard

list.name: Discovery flight
list.length: 1 hour at the school: 15-minute briefing, about 40 minutes in the air
list.before: paid in full when booking (gift certificates too)
list.needs: an instructor and a 2- or 4-seat trainer
list.note: one guest may ride along in the 4-seat trainer, inside the weight limits; a flyer under 18 comes with a parent who signs and stays at the airport

list.name: 2-hour dual lesson (4-seat trainer)
list.price: $470 (example: 2 hours of aircraft at $165 an hour plus the instructor at $70 an hour)
list.before: a card saved for the $75 fee
list.after: the saved card is charged at DONE for the block; a flight that runs past the block needs the student's yes first
list.needs: the student's instructor and a 4-seat trainer
list.note: the 2-seat trainer is the same block at $410 (example); the block is the price, never a meter

list.name: 1-hour ground lesson
list.where: at the school, or by video
list.before: a card saved for the $75 fee
list.after: paid at the front desk after; a video lesson's saved card is charged at DONE

list.name: 1-hour simulator session
list.before: a card saved for the $75 fee
list.after: paid at the front desk after
list.needs: the simulator; an instructor unless the pilot is current and checked out on it

list.name: Supervised solo flight (1-hour block)
list.before: a card saved for the $75 fee
list.after: the saved card is charged at DONE
list.needs: an aircraft, and an instructor on duty at the school for the whole flight
list.note: only with a student pilot certificate, a current medical (or the federal rule's alternative), the instructor's solo endorsement in date, and the weather inside the student's own limits; never sold to a student under 16

list.name: Flight review at the school (2-hour block)
list.price: $470 (example, the same block as a dual lesson)
list.length: about 2 hours: ground, flight and debrief
list.before: a card saved for the $75 fee
list.after: the saved card is charged at DONE

list.name: Checkride warm-up (2-hour block)
list.length: the day of the practical test: a warm-up flight with the instructor, then the examiner
list.before: a card saved for the $75 fee
list.after: the saved card is charged at DONE
list.note: the examiner sets the date and is paid directly by the student, outside Rosie; the date can't move

list.name: Private pilot ground school course
list.kind: one price, seats in a session
list.after: the $299 rest paid at the front desk at the first evening
list.capacity: 12 seats; runs with at least 4 by 7 days before the first evening

list.name: Flight review in the customer's own aircraft (flow B)
list.price: $255 (example: 3 hours of instructor time at $85 an hour)
list.length: about 3 hours: 1 hour ground, 2 hours flight
list.where: at the customer's own airport and aircraft
list.before: a card saved for the $75 fee
list.after: the saved card is charged at DONE
list.note: the aircraft is the owner's: airworthy, inspected and insured so the instructor may fly it

list.name: Transition training in the customer's own aircraft (flow B)
list.price: $1,200 estimate (example): a $300 deposit (25%) now and the $900 rest on the bill after the last visit
list.where: at the customer's own airport and aircraft
list.after: the $900 rest on the bill after the last visit
list.note: the insurer's required hours set the number of visits

list.name: Ground school class seat at a host's place (flow B)
list.where: at a host's place, like a flying club or a school

pf.services.capacity: one instructor per lesson; each aircraft and the simulator is booked like a room, so a lesson shows a time only if the instructor and the aircraft are both free; an instructor must be on duty for any supervised solo
pf.services.online: ground lessons may be by video; flight and simulator time never
pf.services.outOfScope: renting an aircraft to a licensed pilot with no instruction is renting a thing for a time, which Rosie doesn't book (Jay, Oct 24); a pilot's checkout flight, currency flight and flight review are booked as lessons

beforeTimes: new to flying, a student pilot, or a licensed pilot (sets the service: a discovery flight, the next lesson, a solo, a flight review or checkout)
what the lesson is for, and the next stage of training if the student knows it
which aircraft type, if the pilot is checked out in one
for a discovery flight: how many people fly, and whether a guest under 18 is coming
for a flight in the customer's own aircraft (flow B): the airport and the aircraft type
afterTime: anything the instructor should know (last lesson's topic, nerves)
for a solo: the practice area or route the instructor agreed
securePage: each person's weight for the flight, for the aircraft's weight limits (never in a text, never through the AI)
the student's date of birth (age limits for solo and for certificates)
proof of citizenship, or the date of the school's federal security approval for a student who isn't a citizen, where the federal rules require it before training
the student pilot certificate and medical certificate: kind and end date (for a solo)
for the customer's own aircraft: the owner's name, the yearly inspection date, and the insurance showing the instructor may fly it
the waiver and the school's training agreement
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or legal guardian books for anyone under 18 and signs their OK; a teen who starts a booking forwards the link to a parent

stop.words: an aircraft crash or fire happening now, someone hurt at the airport, an aircraft overdue or missing
stop.say: Call 911 now. Stay clear of any aircraft that is burning or leaking fuel.

goOn.words: feeling sick, very tired, on a new medicine, or drinking in the last 8 hours before a flight
goOn.what: no flying that day for the person at the controls (the federal alcohol rule and the school's own fitness rule); the booking moves with no fee before the cutoff, or turns into a ground lesson; Rosie gives no medical advice

goOn.words: a health condition that may affect flying, a medical certificate that was denied or ran out
goOn.what: it goes on the secure page only; the school decides what may be booked (dual lessons need no medical; a solo does)
the booking goes on; the instructor is told privately to go gently

pf.safety.fitness: the instructor checks that the student is fit to fly before every flight (the school's own checklist); a student who isn't fit doesn't fly that day
pf.safety.weather: the instructor decides go or no-go from the weather at the airport before each flight, against the school's limits and the student's own limits; a flight that can't go becomes a ground or simulator lesson, or moves with no fee
pf.safety.aircraft: an aircraft with a defect found on the preflight check doesn't fly until it's fixed
pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Waiver and training agreement
steps.when: signed on the secure page while booking, before the first flight
steps.who: every person who flies; a parent or guardian signs for anyone under 18; a discovery flight's guest signs their own
steps.result: signed: it books; not signed in the saved time: the time is let go

steps.name: Proof of citizenship, or the federal security approval
steps.when: on the secure page before the first lesson, checked by the school before the first flight
steps.who: every new student pilot, where the federal rules require it
steps.result: checked: training goes on; not checked by the lesson: a ground lesson only, or the lesson moves with no fee

steps.name: Weight for the flight
steps.when: on the secure page while booking
steps.who: everyone who flies, for the aircraft's weight limits
steps.result: inside the limits: it books; over: another aircraft type, fewer people, or no flight, before any money is taken

steps.name: Medical and student pilot certificate
steps.when: before a supervised solo, on the secure page, and shown at the front desk
steps.result: in date: the solo books; missing or ended: a dual lesson instead, or no solo

steps.name: Instructor's solo endorsement
steps.who: the student's own instructor gives it
steps.goodFor: the time the federal rules set (90 days), or as the instructor limits it
steps.result: in date: the solo books; ended: a dual flight first

steps.name: The owner's aircraft papers (flow B)
steps.when: on the secure page before a flight in the customer's own aircraft
steps.result: the yearly inspection in date and insurance that lets the instructor fly it: it goes ahead; missing: the instructor gives ground only, or it moves

pf.first_steps.prep: bring the logbook, a photo ID, the headset if you have one, and the student pilot and medical certificates for a solo; eat first; check in 15 minutes early

pf.visit.checkIn: at the front desk: the check-in code and the photo ID; for a solo, the student pilot and medical certificates are shown; the class roster for ground school; at the customer's own airport (flow B): the code at the hangar
pf.visit.beforeWork: the instructor checks the student is fit to fly, checks the weather against the limits, and does the preflight check of the aircraft with the student; no flight if any check fails
pf.visit.changes: weather or an aircraft defect turns the flight into a ground or simulator lesson, or moves it with no fee; a flight that goes longer than the block is billed at the same rates from the meter, and more than 30 minutes over needs the student's yes first
pf.visit.done: the aircraft's meter reading in and out, the instructor's hours, and DONE; the instructor signs the student's logbook and fills the training record
pf.visit.record: the training record and logbook entry (date, aircraft, hours, what was taught, any endorsement), kept as the federal rules require
pf.visit.children: a parent stays at the airport for a discovery flight or lesson under 16; a student pilot of 16 or 17 may come alone with the parent's signed OK on file and is handed back only to an adult on the pick-up list if one is named

pf.money.before: a discovery flight and the ground school course are paid in full or with a deposit when booking; lessons and solos save a card for the fee; the course's rest is paid at the first evening, never charged later on its own
pf.money.after: a lesson block is charged at DONE on the saved card, or a ground lesson paid at the front desk; the course's rest at the first evening; a flight-training series' rest on the bill after the last visit
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form; prepaid training money kept apart or bonded where the state's rules require it
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel until 24 hours before (the owner's setting); a weather or aircraft cancel by the school is always free
pf.money.fees: a late cancel or no-show: $75 (example), only with the owner's OK, and never more than what was paid now; never for weather, an aircraft defect, or a student who says before the flight that they aren't fit to fly. A student who arrives impaired (drinking in the last 8 hours, or drugs) doesn't fly, and it's treated like a late cancel: any fee is the owner's call.
pf.money.refunds: a lesson the school cancels is never charged; unused ground school evenings are refunded under the course terms; an unused block of hours is refunded under its terms
pf.money.tax: where the state's rules tax aircraft time or instruction
pf.money.fee2: Rosfield's $2 applies: one $2 per confirmed booking; a series of transition visits counts once
pf.money.goods: headsets, logbooks, charts and pilot supplies are the school's own sale at the front desk, outside Rosie

pf.messages.never: weight, date of birth, medical certificate details, health answers, citizenship papers and certificate numbers never go in a text: only the secure page
pf.messages.staffTexts: texts to instructors name the student and the lesson only; the weight and certificate details open on the secure page
pf.messages.minors: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian

pf.staff.licenses: each instructor's federal flight instructor certificate and ratings are the school's own word, shown to the owner; not checked by Rosie (D96)
pf.staff.skills: discovery flights, primary training, instrument, multi-engine, tailwheel, checkout flights, flight reviews, simulator, ground school, stage checks (the chief instructor or a second instructor)
pf.staff.supervision: a supervised solo needs an instructor on duty at the school for the whole flight; the student's own instructor gives the endorsement
pf.staff.oks: the student's instructor OKs each solo and its weather limits; the chief instructor OKs stage checks and checkride sign-offs; the owner OKs fees, refunds and new renters
pf.staff.standIn: another instructor with the same ratings may take a lesson, offered to the student first, never assumed; a stage check must be with a different instructor
pf.staff.dutyLimits: an instructor gives no more than 8 hours of flight training in 24 hours (the federal rule as a switch)
pf.staff.away: only instructors cleared by the owner fly customers' own aircraft (flow B)
pf.staff.certificates: each instructor's certificate end date, if the school enters one: a reminder for the owner only

pf.rules.aircraft: aircraft used for hire or instruction have the inspections the federal rules require; an aircraft past one isn't offered
pf.rules.training: training records and logbook endorsements as the federal rules require; the school's own syllabus decides the next lesson
pf.rules.solo: a solo needs the student pilot certificate, a medical (or the federal rule's alternative), the instructor's endorsement in date, and an instructor on duty; the business's own word on each one
pf.rules.security: a student who isn't a citizen: the school's own federal approval step, before flight training starts; the school keeps the proof itself; Rosie never checks a document (D96)
pf.rules.alcohol: no flying within 8 hours of drinking or while impaired (the federal rule, and the school's own rule)
pf.rules.school: where the state's rules license flight schools as private or vocational schools: the enrollment contract, its cancel window and any bond for prepaid training (a switch)
pf.rules.records: training records, waivers and agreements kept as long as the federal rules ask, and at least 7 years

pf.edges.weather: weather below the limits: the instructor decides before the flight; a ground or simulator lesson at the same time, or a move with no fee
pf.edges.aircraft: an aircraft down for a defect or an inspection: another aircraft of the same type, a simulator or ground lesson, or a move with no fee
pf.edges.notFit: a student who isn't fit to fly: no flight; a ground lesson, or a move
pf.edges.checkride: the checkride date is set by the examiner and can't move: the school keeps the aircraft and offers another of the same type if one goes down
pf.edges.late: a late student: the lesson is shorter inside the block, or becomes ground only
pf.edges.overrun: the flight runs past the block: billed from the meter; more than 30 minutes over needs the student's yes
pf.edges.minor: a student under 18: a parent books and signs; a solo at 16 and up only
pf.edges.noShow: a no-show: the fee only with the owner's OK
pf.edges.standIn: the student's instructor out: another instructor with the ratings, offered first, or a move
pf.edges.emergency: an incident in flight is handled by the instructor and the federal reporting rules; Rosie tells the owner at once and says nothing to anyone else
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way

notes:
Built Oct 27 by Haiku builder C4 from driving-school (refitted, 0/0) and the Oct 24 flight sample plug-in (test-drive kept: its verified gaps are in work/gaps/flight-school.json).
Money is by block, not by meter: the 2-hour dual lesson is $470 (2 hours of aircraft at $165 plus the instructor at $70); a flight past the block needs the student's yes first (the master's rule). This closes test-drive gap 1 without a new rule.
Paths A: card|card dual lesson ($470, fee $75, charged at DONE); card|counter 1-hour ground lesson ($90, fee $75, desk); full|none discovery flight ($149); deposit|counter ground school course ($399: $100 deposit now, $299 rest at the front desk at the first evening; no set-day charge, D65).
Paths B: card|card flight review in the customer's own aircraft ($255, fee $75, DONE); full|none ground school seat at a host's place ($45, fee $40); deposit|bill transition series ($1,200 estimate: $300 deposit, $900 rest on the bill after the last visit).
D96: no license, certificate or insurance is checked by Rosie. S1-60 'A license' off, S2-28 'Yes, each one' off, D96 steps S1-32 to S13-11 off (as the golf pilot did), words on S1-60, S1-61, S2-28, S2-29 say nothing is looked up.
D97: the $2 applies; S1-62 'No $2' off. S2-30 sent now off; no sent-now or on-call branch is on.
Health privacy agreement (S1-71 'Yes: sign it now') off: this is not health care. Medical certificate, citizenship and weight answers stay on the secure page.
Sensitive switch OFF (decision for the verifier): the flight school's medical answers are asked on the secure page; the master keeps health details out of texts. Main-session rule: sensitive is for health and grief work.
Confirmations (A6-14, B6-13): a words op sets the card title to the generic 'Flight booking' because the master's service-name slot shows the example name on every path (MASTER line in the log).
Children: a discovery flight or lesson under 16 has a parent at the airport; a student pilot of 16 or 17 may come alone with the parent's signed OK (A8-67 kept both). Solos are for certificate holders only.
Splits kept: S1-60, S1-80 (aircraft and simulator as spaces), A4-43, A4-66 (person, seat, space), A7-59, A7-15, A7-63 (checkride date set by the examiner), A7-68, A8-02, A8-67, S11-87, S11-90; B: S1-60, S1-38, S1-80, B4-78 (aircraft owned by someone else), B5-34, B7-62, S11-87, S11-90.
Not sure (verifier): block pricing for a school that also flies shorter; whether the 2-seat trainer block ($410) should be a path; the impaired student and fee (owner's call; a gap in A8-51); the 8-hour duty rule is the owner's own rule (a switch in the master is not live).
